The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra SIR: Lists of ‘logical discrepancies’, ‘unmapped persons’ yet to be published
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Sources in the CEO’s office say process of publication is ongoing at ERO level, without offering any timeframe for its completion; claims and objections window open till October 26

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra FDA bans loose spice powder sales, orders Statewide crackdown on adulteration
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Food Safety Commissioner’s order bans prohibited colouring agents, including Metanil Yellow and Rhodamine B, and adulterants such as brick powder and chalk, and requires all spice powders to be packed and sealed at the place of production before sale

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Anti-CEC protest: Actor Imran Khan issued notice, asked to leave India by October 28
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Action against Imran Khan has been initiated under Section 7 of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, senior officials told The Hindu; the action comes after the actor participated in anti-CEC protest in Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan on October 10, where protesters demanded the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Tata Trusts row: Noel, son Neville Tata move Bombay HC and Mumbai civil court with caveats
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Both the father and son moved the courts with their caveats on October 7, as per official records

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Pune to suspend water supply every Thursday from October 15
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: PMC has pointed out that in the Khadakwasla dam, which provides water to Pune, as of October 12, water storage is less compared to the available water storage every year

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Thane Police bust matrimonial fraud racket, arrest two men; ₹14.25 lakh cash, 311 grams of gold seized
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The accused have been identified as Dinesh Babu Manekar (39), a resident of Mahape in Navi Mumbai, and his alleged accomplice Suresh alias Babu Tanaji Mhatre (55), a resident of Chikhali in Raigad district

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Education Ministry forms panel to investigate student’s death at IIIT Ranchi
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Committee has been mandated to examine the circumstances surrounding the incident

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Coast Guard seizes fishing boat for suspected diesel smuggling off Mumbai coast
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: “During the preliminary investigation, the master of the vessel confessed to receiving about 4,000 litres of illicit diesel at sea,” the Coast Guard said

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: IIT-B student death: Sahil Wakode apologised for cheating in exam, sought second chance, say cops
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Sahil Wakode, a second-year BTech student, was found dead in his hostel room on the evening of September 18,

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Now, an electoral roll cyber scam rocks Maharashtra
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Recently, a 79-year-old man lost ₹11.92 lakh. The case raises questions about how banking credentials were compromised and whether personal information associated with electoral applications was obtained through phishing or other means

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: MPSC paper leak: Bhimanwar on leave; Tukaram Mundhe to be secretary of committee for inquiry
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Subsequently, Maharashtra Public Service Commission Chairman Vivek Bhimanwar announced that he had proceeded on leave till the inquiry was completed

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Modi government waging war against citizens to protect CEC: Abhijeet Dipke
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The CJP convenor alleged youth, journalists and MPs were being assaulted by the Delhi Police, as he visited his native village after his grandmother’s last rites

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: MPSC paper leak case: Mumbai Crime Branch arrests another accused
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The case relates to the alleged leak of the question paper for the MPSC Drug Inspector (Group B) recruitment examination held in March 2026

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Big victory for students, youth: Rahul on MPSC protest
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: MPSC Chairman Vivek Bhimanwar announced that he had proceeded on leave till the inquiry was completed

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Many detained near Shivaji Park as Mumbai Police prevent protest against CEC
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Some allege that people merely standing or walking in the area were also taken into custody

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Tushar Gandhi among 12 named in FIR over Mumbai protest; 600 detained and released
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The protest was organised by Hum Bharat Ke Log in solidarity with CJP and Left groups’ protest in Delhi, demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and others

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Tushar Gandhi, Imran Khan among 600 protesters detained in Mumbai
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Police barricade road leading to August Kranti Maidan; hundreds of students, activists protest outside maidan

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Abhijeet Dipke’s grandmother Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke passes away
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Savitribai Shankarrao Dipke breathed her last at 11.30 a.m. at the paternal house in Santuk Pimpri village

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: 11-year-old tribal student of Thane ashram school dies after fever; three officials suspended
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Vivek Subhash Bhoye, a Class 5 student, died in Maharashtra’s Thane district after the school allegedly delayed informing his mother and failed to provide timely medical treatment

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: PIL in Bombay HC seeks filling of posts in 14 Maharashtra government bodies
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The PIL says that the MPSC published its report for 2022–23 only in July 2026 and omitted appendix data on staff workloads

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Bombay HC questions NIA on Waze’s bail appeal; expresses surprise at Waze’s assets
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The court sought answers from the agency regarding the impact of releasing Waze

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Two police constables among five arrested by Mumbai Police in illegal telecom data racket
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Police said investigators identified nine accused in the network supplying call detail records (CDRs), subscriber detail records (SDRs) and mobile phone location information

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Police send notices to students, CJP supporters ahead of October 10 Delhi protest
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Maharashtra police have sent notices and made calls to students and CJP supporters, invoking Section 168 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, asking them not to join the Saturday (October 10, 2026) protest in Delhi

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Mumbai Police ban firecrackers, laser lights on public roads till December 4 following HC order
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The order, issued under Section 163 of the BNSS, follows a Bombay High Court direction on curbing noise and environmental pollution during festivals

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Special voter registration camps in colleges and house-to-house verification campaign
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Voter Registration Officers have set up the camps for disposal of notices/claims and objections and enrolment of all eligible electors

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Mumbai-based activist and AISF delegation allege detention by State police
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: All India Students’ Federation (AISF) members alleged that police attempted to arbitrarily detain a student delegation travelling aboard the 12779 Goa Express from Pune to New Delhi.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: ED attaches assets worth ₹567.45 crore in PACL case
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Enforcement Directorate has provisionally attached 48 immovable properties in Maharashtra linked to accused Prateek Kumar and his associates
